name: flip-card
title: Flip Card
blurb: 3D card that rotates 180° to reveal a back face on hover.
description: A 3D card with perspective transform that flips on group hover, revealing back-face content. Supports rotation around X or Y axis. Front and back are independently positioned.
use_when: Interactive card decks, product showcases with alternate details, or memory-game-style UIs where reverse reveal adds…
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces where persistent flip state or multi-card coordination could create usability friction.
a11y: Front/back faces have separate elements with independent content; focus and keyboard nav depend on children. No prefers-reduced-motion guard; 3D effects always apply.
